我们需要回答SQL。需要理解：全部订单中有过任意退款记录的订单占比。不排订单状态，按订单去重，输出0到1小数四位，分母0时NULL。

需要一条SELECT。分母订单总数 count(*) from orders? 全部订单。分子有过任意退款记录的订单数，按订单去重。refunds 可能有多个退款记录同订单。需要 count distinct r.order_id 或 distinct orders with exists. 占比 = count(distinct refunds.order_id) / count(orders.order_id) 注意只算退款订单在orders中的？ "全部订单中有过任意退款记录" 分子应订单在全部订单中且存在退款。如果 refunds 有孤儿订单？FK? 可能是约定。应该用 orders LEFT JOIN refunds 或 EXISTS。按订单去重且不排状态。输出小数四位，ROUND(...::numeric,4)。分母0 NULLIF.

SQL:
SELECT ROUND(
 COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),0), 4
) AS refund_order_ratio
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id;

这样 COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) 只算 orders 中匹配的退款订单，且按订单去重。分母 orders distinct. orders PK so count(*) okay. 但如果 refunds 多行，COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) unaffected. 为避免重复, left join. 结果一行，聚合无group，无需limit? Rule 3 单行无GROUP BY的COUNT/SUM/AVG等聚合除外。可以不加limit. 输出别名。需要0到1小数四位。ROUND numeric.

Check "有过任意退款记录" 不要求退款状态，任意记录包括待审核等。不排订单状态。分母全部订单。按订单去重。用 LEFT JOIN.

Potential issue if refunds contains order_id not in orders: not counted numerator, which aligns "全部订单中". Good.

Could do EXISTS to avoid duplicates:
SELECT ROUND(
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),4)
FROM orders o;
This counts orders with any refund and denominator. Simpler no overcount. Uses FILTER aggregate. COUNT(*) with FILTER returns bigint. Numeric cast. If orders empty? left join count distinct returns 0 denominator 0 -> NULL. EXISTS version also 0/0 null. Both okay. Use EXISTS maybe robust and "按订单去重". But when counting numerator: COUNT(*) FILTER where exists. Yes.

Need only output SQL. No code fences. Ensure no quoting. Column names lower. The SQL uses refunds table. The "不排订单状态" no filter. "输出0到1小数四位" ROUND(...,4).

SELECT ROUND(
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id))::numeric
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
  4
) AS refund_order_ratio
FROM orders o;

Could denominator count all orders; if no orders aggregate returns one row with 0 numerator? Actually count(*)=0, count filter=0, division null => ROUND(NULL,4) null. Good.

Need maybe alias "ratio". Fine.
